The '''Neelgaimon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Neelgaimon system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neelgaimon]].
